key_findings: EA reduced TNI-induced mechanical allodynia and partially reversed contralateral S1 DNA hypermethylation.
RNA-seq showed region-specific DEGs in S1 and ACC, with mitochondrial/inflammatory pathways in ACC and gephyrin changes in ipsilateral S1.
